web_events.query: China PMI economic data this week
web_events.answer: China's April economic data showed a slowdown with retail sales growth at 0.2%, significantly below the expected 2% and a deceleration from March's 1.7%. Industrial output increased by 4.1%, missing forecasts of 5.9% and slowing from March's 5.7%. Investment fell by 1.6% in the first four months, contrasting with the 1.7% growth in the first quarter. Despite these underwhelming figures, Deloitte's chief economist believes China will meet its growth target without major stimulus.
